While major indices remain near record highs, a 'K-shaped' recovery is evident: large-cap technology and AI infrastructure names face elevated expectations, whereas financials and defensive healthcare are benefiting from a combination of fundamental turnarounds and positive guidance updates. Energy and utility stocks, particularly those linked to AI data center power demand, are seeing increased institutional interest following significant federal loan commitments and long-term contracts with hyperscalers.
